description: This Java class 'Fund' models a fund allocation or release record associated with a project in a tourism infrastructure monitoring system. It defines fields like id, project, date, amount, type, and reference, and includes getter and setter methods for each. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping to a database table 'funds'.
